conventions.kite: sum_i z^i Q_i(theta_z), theta_z = z d/dz, acting on phi(z) = Phi~(sqrt z)
conventions.Y: sum_i t^(2i) Q_i(theta_t) on Y_log = t^3 sum binom(-3/2,n) phi_n t^(2n); theta-form lists are sum_k c_k(x) theta_t^k with x = t^2, flint polynomial strings in x
conventions.maps: Legendre: A = (N0 + N1 d/dx)/E from L_Leg(gamma) (degree -1/2 in z = (t^2+1-gamma^2)/(2t), twisted by x^(1/2)) into C2b; K3: A = t^s (x-4)^-b sum_j N_j(x) theta^j from F_3's operator into F
